name: online-shops-platform
description: A comprehensive online chain of shops platform with multiple interfaces for clients, shop owners, administrators, and customer care

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:shop-owner" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:customer-care"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:client && npm run build:shop-owner && npm run build:admin && npm run build:customer-care
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:client && npm run test:shop-owner && npm run test:admin && npm run test:customer-care
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:client && npm run lint:shop-owner && npm run lint:admin && npm run lint:customer-care
scripts.install:all: concurrently "cd backend && npm install" "cd client-frontend && npm install" "cd shop-owner-dashboard && npm install" "cd admin-panel && npm install" "cd customer-care-dashboard && npm install"
scripts.clean: npm run clean:backend && npm run clean:client && npm run clean:shop-owner && npm run clean:admin && npm run clean:customer-care

author: Online Shops Platform Team
